title: Roast Chicken
description: A Chef Aly Thermomix reinterpretation of Thomas Keller's famous simple roast chicken — golden, juicy, with perfectly crisp skin. Metric ingredients and exact TM6 and TM7 times, temperatures and speeds for Australian home cooks.
intro: Thomas Keller's roast chicken is the dish that proves simplicity wins — just butter, salt, pepper and a hot oven. This Chef Aly Thermomix version makes the compound butter and stuffing in the bowl, then roasts to golden perfection. Fewer ingredients, more flavour.
ingredients: 1 whole chicken (about 1.6 kg), giblets removed, patted dry
4 garlic cloves, 2 left whole and 2 peeled
steps: Preheat oven to 230°C (210°C fan-forced). Place onion, carrot and celery in the bottom of a roasting pan to form a rack.
Place the 2 peeled garlic cloves and 3 sprigs of thyme in the mixing bowl. Chop 5 sec / speed 7. Scrape down.
Add the softened butter, ½ tsp sea salt and ¼ tsp black pepper. Mix 15 sec / speed 4 until combined into a herb butter.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Gently loosen the skin over the breasts and push two-thirds of the herb butter under the skin, spreading evenly. Rub the remaining butter over the outside of the chicken. Set aside on a plate 5 min / 0°C / speed 0 while you prepare the cavity.

Stuff the cavity with the lemon halves, 2 whole garlic cloves, remaining thyme and 2 sprigs of rosemary. Tie the legs together with kitchen twine. Set aside 5 min / 0°C / speed 0 to let the butter firm slightly before roasting.

Place the chicken on top of the vegetables in the roasting pan. Place 250 g water in the mixing bowl and set the Varoma dish on top. This step is for cleaning the bowl only — the chicken roasts in the oven. Roast at 230°C for 15 min / 230°C oven / no speed, then reduce to 190°C.
Continue roasting at 190°C for 50–60 min / 190°C oven / no speed until the juices run clear and the internal temperature reaches 74°C.
Remove from oven, rest 15 min / 0°C / no speed (rest at room temperature, not in the Thermomix). Carve and serve with the pan juices.
tips: The drier the chicken skin before butter application, the crispier it will be. Pat thoroughly with paper towels.
Don't skip the 15-minute rest — it redistributes the juices and keeps the breast meat moist.
The vegetables under the chicken caramelise and make a brilliant quick gravy with the pan juices.

faq.q: Can I make Roast Chicken in a Thermomix TM6 or TM7?
faq.a: The Thermomix prepares the compound herb butter, chops the aromatics and stuffs the cavity. The chicken roasts in a conventional oven for the best crisp skin. Both TM6 and TM7 handle the preparation steps identically.

faq.q: Can I use a larger chicken?
faq.a: Yes. For a 2 kg chicken, add 15–20 minutes to the roasting time at 190°C and always check the internal temperature reaches 74°C at the thickest part of the thigh.
